text.hi: नामों के पहले अक्षर बड़े लिखो (Laxmi Bai, Jhansi, Indian)। वाक्य के अंत में full stop लगाओ।
text.hinglish: Naamon ke pehle akshar bade likho (Laxmi Bai, Jhansi, Indian). Vaakya ke ant mein full stop lagao.
text.en: Names start with capital letters (Laxmi Bai, Jhansi, Indian). Put a full stop at the end of a sentence.

steps.question: Which one has proper punctuation?
options: Maharani Laxmi Bai was a brave queen. She fought against her enemies with great courage and is remembered in Indian history as Jhansi ki Rani.
maharani laxmi bai was a brave queen she fought against her enemies with great courage
Maharani laxmi bai was a brave Queen, she fought against her Enemies.
steps.answer: Maharani Laxmi Bai was a brave queen. She fought against her enemies with great courage and is remembered in Indian history as Jhansi ki Rani.

text.hi: ‘and’ दो मिलती-जुलती बातों को जोड़ता है (और)। ‘but’ दो उल्टी बातों को जोड़ता है (लेकिन)। Ram is tall but Shyam is short.
text.hinglish: ‘and’ do milti-julti baaton ko jodta hai (aur). ‘but’ do ulti baaton ko jodta hai (lekin). Ram is tall but Shyam is short.
text.en: ‘and’ joins two similar ideas. ‘but’ joins two opposite ideas. Ram is tall but Shyam is short.

steps.sentence: Ram ___ Shyam both like to play.

meaning.hi: राम और श्याम दोनों को खेलना पसंद है।
meaning.hinglish: Ram aur Shyam dono ko khelna pasand hai.

steps.sentence: Ram likes to go to school ___ Shyam does not like school at all.

meaning.hi: राम को स्कूल जाना पसंद है लेकिन श्याम को स्कूल बिल्कुल पसंद नहीं।
meaning.hinglish: Ram ko school jaana pasand hai lekin Shyam ko school bilkul pasand nahi.

steps.sentence: Ram keeps his room neat ___ tidy.

meaning.hi: राम अपना कमरा साफ़ और सुथरा रखता है।
meaning.hinglish: Ram apna kamra saaf aur suthra rakhta hai.

steps.sentence: Ram keeps his room tidy ___ Shyam keeps his room untidy.

meaning.hi: राम कमरा साफ़ रखता है लेकिन श्याम गंदा रखता है।
meaning.hinglish: Ram kamra saaf rakhta hai lekin Shyam ganda rakhta hai.

steps.sentence: The spider fell many times ___ it did not give up.

meaning.hi: मकड़ी कई बार गिरी लेकिन उसने हार नहीं मानी।
meaning.hinglish: Makdi kai baar giri lekin usne haar nahi maani.
